name: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Foundational concepts of machine learning, terminology, and real-world application workflows.

name: PCA
description: Linear dimensionality reduction technique maximizing variance along orthogonal principal axes.

name: Representation Learning
description: Extracting meaningful latent representations and embeddings from raw features.

name: Paradigms of Machine Learning
description: Taxonomy of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms.

name: Kernel PCA
description: Non-linear extension of PCA mapping data to high-dimensional Hilbert spaces using the kernel trick.

name: Kernel Functions
description: Inner product evaluation in implicit high-dimensional spaces (RBF, Polynomial, Linear kernels).

name: Feature Transformation
description: Non-linear transformations and basis function expansions for feature spaces.

name: Issues with PCA
description: Computational complexity, sensitivity to outliers, and limitations of linear PCA.

name: Introduction to Clustering
description: Unsupervised partitioning of data points based on geometric distance metrics.

name: K-means Clustering
description: Lloyd's iterative algorithm optimizing cluster centroids by minimizing within-cluster sum of squares.

name: Kernel K-means
lecture_ref: Nature of clusters produced by K-means.docx.md
description: Applying the kernel trick to identify non-linearly separable clusters.

name: K-means Initialization
description: Methods for selecting initial centroids, including K-means++ probabilistic seeding.

name: K-means Convergence
description: Mathematical guarantees, monotonicity of objective function, and local minima in K-means.

name: Choice of K
description: Heuristics and statistical metrics for selecting the optimal number of clusters.

name: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
description: Frequentist parameter estimation maximizing the log-likelihood of observed data.

name: Bayesian Estimation
description: Parameter estimation combining prior beliefs with data likelihood (MAP and posterior distributions).

name: Gaussian Mixture Models
description: Probabilistic clustering modeling data as a mixture of multiple Gaussian distributions.

name: EM Algorithm
description: Iterative Expectation-Maximization framework for finding MLE in latent variable models.

name: Jensen's Inequality
description: Convexity property used to establish the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) in the EM algorithm.

name: Linear Regression
description: Continuous target estimation via Ordinary Least Squares and geometric projection.

name: Gradient Descent
description: First-order iterative optimization algorithm for minimizing differentiable loss functions.

name: Kernel Regression
description: Non-parametric and kernel-based regression methods for non-linear curve fitting.

name: Probabilistic View of Regression
description: Deriving OLS and regularized regression as Maximum Likelihood and MAP under Gaussian noise.

name: Supervised Learning
description: Principles of learning predictive mappings from labeled training pairs.

name: Ridge Regression
description: L2-regularized linear regression preventing multicollinearity and shrinking coefficients.

name: LASSO Regression
description: L1-regularized regression encouraging sparse feature selection through diamond-shaped constraint geometry.

name: Regularization
description: Techniques to combat overfitting by penalizing model complexity in empirical risk minimization.

name: K-Nearest Neighbours
description: Instance-based non-parametric classifier using majority vote among k closest training instances.

name: Decision Trees
description: Hierarchical recursive partitioning model making sequential feature splits.

name: Information Gain
description: Entropy and Gini impurity metrics for selecting optimal split attributes in decision trees.

name: Binary Classification
description: Fundamentals of two-class decision boundaries, 0-1 loss, and evaluation metrics.

name: Naive Bayes
description: Probabilistic classifier applying Bayes theorem under the conditional feature independence assumption.

name: Generative Models
description: Modeling the joint probability distribution P(X, Y) to perform classification via Bayes rule.

name: Discriminative vs Generative
description: Contrasting direct boundary modeling P(Y|X) with joint data distribution modeling P(X, Y).

name: Perceptron
description: Classical linear threshold classifier and error-driven weight update convergence theorem.

name: Logistic Regression
description: Probabilistic linear classification using the sigmoid link function and cross-entropy loss.

name: Discriminative Models
description: Classifiers parameterized directly to model posterior probability P(Y|X) without modeling inputs.

name: Support Vector Machines
description: Maximum-margin hyperplane classifier formulated as quadratic optimization with support vectors.

name: Kernel SVM
description: Dual formulation of SVM operating in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces for non-linear boundaries.

name: Margin Maximization
description: Geometric and functional margin theory, slack variables, and hinge loss in soft-margin SVMs.

name: Ensemble Methods
description: Combining multiple weak learners to reduce variance and bias for superior generalization.

name: Bagging
description: Bootstrap Aggregating training parallel independent estimators to minimize variance.

name: Boosting
description: Sequential ensemble paradigm focusing iteratively on previously misclassified sample weights.

name: AdaBoost
description: Adaptive Boosting algorithm optimizing exponential loss through weighted decision stumps.

name: Artificial Neural Networks
description: Multi-layer feedforward networks with non-linear activations as universal function approximators.

name: Backpropagation
description: Reverse-mode automatic differentiation applying the multivariable calculus chain rule.

name: Multiclass Classification
description: Generalizing binary classifiers to K classes via One-vs-All, One-vs-One, and Softmax categorical cross-entropy.

name: Activation Functions
description: Non-linear node activation functions (Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU) and their gradient properties.
